LESSON: READING SYLLABLES READING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.7: Reading syllables READING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading syllables READING. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we blend letter READING (3 HRS) learners should be able to: in blending sounds to sounds to make syllables?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING SYLLABLES READING
This lesson teaches Reading syllables READING for PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading syllables READING using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading syllables READING above.
2. Explain Reading syllables READING to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading syllables READING.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading syllables READING with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading syllables READING important for a PP2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we blend letter READING (3 HRS) learners should be able to: in blending sounds to sounds to make syllables?
2. What activities would of class. enhance the learner’s ability to read syllables?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
